title: Circles

source.copyright_boundary: Reference-only summary and mechanism extraction; no full-text mirroring.

mechanisms.summary: A remote or non-corporeal presence may resolve gradually into a visible form rather than appear as a binary on/off state.
mechanisms.codex_use: Holographic correspondents, archived witnesses, AI/character presences, and remote participants can phase from signal haze to stable projection with provenance/status visible throughout.

mechanisms.summary: A presence can be perceived first as voice or felt signal, then later as visible projection.
mechanisms.codex_use: Allow audio/text/indicator states to precede full Three.js manifestation, creating a legible presence-state machine.

mechanisms.summary: One participant intentionally shares a remembered/dreamed scene with another through direct experiential transfer.
mechanisms.codex_use: Story Mode and Observer can project a selected memory/dream/reference as a bounded scene object with source, witness, and interpretation lanes kept distinct.

mechanisms.summary: Dream content overlays waking continuity while remaining narratively distinguishable from ordinary present-time observation.
mechanisms.codex_use: Render dreams, simulations, forecasts, and remembered scenes with distinct visual treatment and explicit epistemic labels instead of flattening them into the current world state.

mechanisms.summary: The inability to locate or physically contact someone is represented as a meaningful continuity state rather than simply removing them from the narrative.
mechanisms.codex_use: Presence UI can model absent, unreachable, remote, archived, projected, and co-present as distinct states rather than present/not-present only.

mechanisms.summary: Physical objects can serve as relational and continuity anchors to an absent person.
mechanisms.codex_use: Objects, files, messages, and artefacts may act as provenance anchors that summon related timelines, receipts, relationships, or projections without asserting identity equivalence.

mechanisms.summary: A transition from contemplation/vision into mission action is marked by preparation, team assembly, launch windows, and explicit readiness.
mechanisms.codex_use: Room/tool invocation may use a staged threshold sequence: context -> companions/tools -> readiness -> transition -> active mission state.

ui_translation.rule: The projection may become vivid without changing the epistemic class of the underlying source.

non_inferences: Do not treat fictional Force mechanics as empirical claims.
Do not infer ontology from vividness of presentation.
Do not collapse dream, memory, remote presence, and present observation into one state.
Do not import Star Wars characters or plot into ArcSweep canon without explicit adoption.
